statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-111959 (GHSA-gqmm-qrjq-4c7h) is an out-of-bounds read in Apache Arrow Rust, fixed in arrow 57.3.2 and 58.4.1. Milvus 3.0 includes arrow-data 56.2.0 through the arrow 56 crates that the milvus-storage bridge and its parquet 56 dependency require; both fixed releases are semver-incompatible with arrow 56, so the fix is an upstream arrow migration of the bridge under evaluation. The arrow 57 and 58 copies in the same bridge are at their fixed releases. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gqmm-qrjq-4c7h
